name: Mission Accomplished!
summary: The High Executor praises your work re-engineering the cauldrons. He honors you for serving the Forsaken and the Horde in the face of great danger.

sections.title: A Public Honor
sections.body: The High Executor addresses those gathered in his presence, then names your service to the Forsaken and the Horde. He praises your work on the cauldrons and honors you as a hero of the Horde.

faq.q: Why does the High Executor honor me?
faq.answer: The High Executor honors you for re-engineering the cauldrons and serving the Forsaken and the Horde in the face of danger.
The High Executor publicly praises your service to the Forsaken and the Horde.

faq.q: What does the High Executor call me?
faq.answer: He honors you as a true hero of the Horde.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you are honored for service to the Forsaken and the Horde as a whole.
The High Executor praises your service to the Forsaken and the Horde.
